setup.description: Install and verify determinate-nix, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

version.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

init.description: Determinate Nix service integration: systemd or none.

trustedUsers.description: Comma-separated trusted Nix users or @groups, such as runner,@builders; root is retained. Blank or omitted values add no users. Trust only administrators.

extraConf.description: Comma-separated single-line Nix key=value settings, passed literally to the installer. Quote CSV entries containing commas. Blank or omitted values add no settings.
